gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-krub: Commanding Impact Label stacks its heavy letters like separate beads, each one standing on its own. Krub keeps a tall, pronounced lowercase beneath it, so the body text can be sized modestly without losing presence.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-kufam: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label sets its letters apart one by one, with a low x-height guide above. Kufam follows in a sans drawn like neon tubing, its wide-open e curves and dominant letter bodies giving the heading plenty of room.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-lexend: Chunky, spaced-out capitals up top, each letter standing alone like a bead on a rod, with open pincer-shaped c ends. Lexend answers in a sans with outsized lowercase and no thick-to-thin shifts.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-lexend-deca: Commanding letters in Impact Label stand apart like beads on a rod, heavy and deliberate. Lexend Deca slips underneath in a plain, unshaded sans-serif line, where diagonals weigh exactly what the verticals do.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-liter: Liter draws its sans lowercase tall and wide-mouthed, as if sketched with a pencil that never presses harder. And Impact Label sits above it, heavy and commanding, each letter separate like a bead on a rod.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-mada: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label spaces its letters like beads on a rod, with c-ends splayed like pincers. Mada comes in underneath as a plain sans with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-martel-sans: Impact Label arrives heavy and commanding, each letter alone like a bead on a rod. And Martel Sans carries the text with generous curve openings and a high mean line, so a long passage should read smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-matangi: Matangi reads as flat, single-weight linework, like twine pressed into a surface, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. Its strongest quality is how it hushes Impact Label's heavy, bead-like capitals.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro runs a flat, unswelling line along every curve, with a welcoming gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. And Impact Label looms over it, heavy and commanding, so the two feel like a shout and a murmur.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-michroma: Separate, bead-like letters give Impact Label its heavy, commanding look, with c-ends pointing apart like open pincers. Michroma replies in sans-serif with wide berths on both sides and a tall-bodied lowercase, leaving daylight in every curve.
